overview:
**Moderate fire danger today, driven mainly by very low afternoon humidity (18%) that trips one of the area's seven local watchout thresholds.**
- Danger stays Moderate through Saturday before rising to High Sunday as fuel dryness (ERC/BI) climbs toward the upper 60th percentile.
- Light NNE-NE winds near 7-8 mph continue, with better humidity recovery and scattered rain arriving midweek before another dry stretch.
- Only 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds is met today (low minimum RH); no Red Flag Warning is posted, and NWS reports no active alerts.
Montrose County lifted Stage 1 fire restrictions for all unincorporated areas effective 12:01 a.m. Wednesday, September 16. Gunnison County is not currently under fire restrictions as of September 18. Delta County remains under Stage 1 fire restrictions effective 9/4/2026.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire on the Gunnison National Forest in Gunnison County is at 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with full containment estimated Oct. 31.
